sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:202619
Court No. - 75
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 41279 of 2023

Applicant :- Shiv Prakash Singh
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Ashok Kumar Singh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Umesh Chandra Sharma,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant bail application has been filed with a prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.272 of 2023, under Sections 379, 411, 413, 401, 420 IPC, Police Station Phoolpur, District Prayagraj, during the pendency of trial.
3. It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.

It is also contended that similarly placed co-accused person, Shailendra Singh has already been enlarged on bail by this Court vide order dated 18.10.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.41254 of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.41254 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Criminal history of the applicant has been explained in paragraphs-9 of the affidavit filed in support of the bail application in which the applicant has already been enlarged on bail.

He further submitted that since the role of the applicant is identical to that of aforesaid co-accused who has already been enlarged on bail, he is also entitled to be enlarged on bail on the ground of parity.
There is no likelihood of his abscondence or tampering with the evidence.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 27.07.2023.

In case the applicant is released on Shiv Prakash Singh vs State Of U.P. on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79003028/
1 bail, he will not misuse the said liberty.

entities.text: Shiv Prakash Singh vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. The prayer for bail has been vehemently opposed by learned AGA.
However, he could not dispute the aforesaid factual aspects of parity to the co-accused.

5. Considering the facts, circumstances and the submissions made but without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for grant of bail on the ground of parity.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.

Order Date :- 19.10.2023 Shahroz  Shiv Prakash Singh vs State Of U.P. on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79003028/
